name: Email Template Editor
description: Block-based email template editor with merge-field insertion at the cursor, unknown-token and link validation, subject length warning, block reordering and a live desktop/mobile inbox preview.

props.name: mergeFields
props.description: { key, label, sample, fallback? } tokens usable as {{key}}

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: { name, subject, preheader, blocks } controlled or initial template

props.name: onSave
props.description: Shows the Save button; disabled while validation issues exist

props.name: subjectLimit
props.description: Rendered subject length that triggers a truncation warning

usage: findUnknownTokens() and renderMerge() are exported for server-side checks.
